categories.name: Website
categories.description: Marketing and content pages that need to inform, convince and convert.

categories.name: Web app
categories.description: Logged-in product screens where people get real work done.

categories.name: Mobile
categories.description: Native and mobile-first screens built for thumbs, interruptions and small screens.

categories.name: Design system
categories.description: Foundations and components that every other screen is built from.

categories.name: Flows
categories.description: Multi-step journeys where a single broken step loses the user.

checklists.title: Landing Page
checklists.description: A single page whose job is to turn a visitor into a sign-up, lead or buyer.

items.title: Value proposition above the fold
items.description: A headline that says what it is and who it is for, readable in under five seconds.
items.tip: Test it: cover the logo — could the headline belong to a competitor?

items.title: One primary call to action
items.description: A single, visually dominant action repeated at natural decision points down the page.

items.title: Social proof near the CTA
items.description: Logos, numbers, reviews or quotes placed where doubt is highest — next to the ask.

items.title: Show the product
items.description: A real screenshot, demo or video instead of abstract illustration only.

items.title: Answer objections
items.description: Pricing hints, security, setup time and cancellation addressed before the visitor has to ask.

items.title: Fast largest contentful paint
items.description: Hero renders in under 2.5s on a mid-range phone over 4G; hero image is sized and preloaded.

items.title: Share metadata
items.description: Title, description and a 1200×630 Open Graph image so links look intentional when shared.

items.title: CTA reachable on mobile
items.description: Primary action visible without hunting on a 375px screen; consider a sticky bar on long pages.

checklists.title: Pricing
checklists.description: Helps a buyer pick the right plan and feel safe paying for it.

items.title: Plans named by who they serve
items.description: Plan names and one-line summaries map to customer types, not internal tiers.

items.title: A recommended plan
items.description: One plan is highlighted to reduce choice paralysis.

items.title: Clear billing period
items.description: Monthly/annual toggle shows the saving and the price per month the user actually pays.
items.tip: Show the annual total too — surprises at checkout kill trust.

items.title: Feature comparison
items.description: A scannable table of differences between plans, with shared features grouped instead of repeated.

items.title: Currency and tax stated
items.description: Currency, whether tax is included, and regional pricing are explicit.

items.title: Path for large teams
items.description: A contact or custom option for buyers who don't fit the published plans.

items.title: Billing FAQ
items.description: Refunds, cancellation, trials and plan changes answered on the page.

checklists.title: Blog Post
checklists.description: Long-form content that should be comfortable to read and easy to share.

items.title: Comfortable line length
items.description: Body text between 60 and 80 characters per line with at least 1.5 line height.

items.title: Author, date and reading time
items.description: Shown near the title so readers can judge freshness and commitment.

items.title: Real heading hierarchy
items.description: One h1, sequential h2/h3 — doubles as a skimmable outline and screen-reader navigation.

items.title: Images have alt text
items.description: Informative images describe their content; decorative ones use empty alt.

items.title: Table of contents for long posts
items.description: Anchored links for posts longer than ~1,500 words.

items.title: A next step at the end
items.description: Related posts, newsletter sign-up or product CTA so the reader doesn't hit a dead end.

items.title: Readable code blocks
items.description: Syntax highlighting, horizontal scroll instead of wrapping, and a copy button.

checklists.title: Contact Us
checklists.description: Gets people to the right human with the least effort.

items.title: Routes by intent
items.description: Separate paths for sales, support, press and partnerships so messages land with the right team.

items.title: Minimal form
items.description: Only the fields needed to reply — usually name, email and message.

items.title: Expected response time
items.description: Tell people when they'll hear back, before and after submitting.

items.title: Self-serve shortcut
items.description: Link to help center or status page for questions that don't need a person.

items.title: Alternative channels
items.description: Email address, phone or chat for people who won't fill a form.

items.title: Spam protection without friction
items.description: Honeypots or invisible checks before resorting to CAPTCHAs.

checklists.title: 404 Page
checklists.description: Turns a dead end into a way back.

items.title: Plain-language explanation
items.description: Says the page couldn't be found without jargon like 'HTTP 404' as the headline.

items.title: Search box
items.description: Lets people look for what they wanted right there.

items.title: Useful links
items.description: Home plus the most visited sections.

items.title: Correct status code
items.description: Server actually returns 404 so the URL drops out of search indexes.

items.title: Report a broken link
items.description: A lightweight way to flag where the bad link came from.

items.title: Keeps site navigation
items.description: Header and footer stay so the user isn't stranded.

checklists.title: FAQ
checklists.description: Answers repeated questions before they become support tickets.

items.title: Questions customers actually ask
items.description: Sourced from support tickets and sales calls, phrased in their words.

items.title: Grouped by topic
items.description: Billing, account, product, security — not one long list.

items.title: Accessible accordions
items.description: Triggers are buttons with aria-expanded; content is reachable by keyboard.

items.title: Linkable answers
items.description: Each answer has an anchor so support can link directly to it.

items.title: Searchable
items.description: Filter or page search for FAQs with more than ~15 entries.

items.title: Contact fallback
items.description: A clear way to reach a person when the answer isn't there.

checklists.title: Footer
checklists.description: The safety net for people who scrolled all the way down looking for something.

items.title: Links grouped by intent
items.description: Product, company, resources, legal — each with a short heading.

items.title: Legal links
items.description: Privacy, terms, cookie settings and imprint where required.

items.title: Readable contrast
items.description: Footer text meets 4.5:1 even though it's de-emphasised.

items.title: Newsletter or social
items.description: A low-commitment way to stay in touch.

items.title: Language / region switcher
items.description: For multi-locale sites, discoverable here as well as in the header.

checklists.title: Dashboard
checklists.description: The home screen after login: what changed, what matters, what to do next.

items.title: Orientation
items.description: Tells returning users what changed since their last visit.

items.title: A few meaningful metrics
items.description: 3–5 numbers tied to the user's goals, each with a time range and comparison.
items.tip: A number without a comparison is trivia.

items.title: Next best action
items.description: Surfaces tasks that need a decision instead of burying them in other views.

items.title: Resume work
items.description: Recently opened or edited items one click away.

items.title: First-run state
items.description: A useful empty dashboard for new accounts with sample data or setup steps.

items.title: Independent loading
items.description: Widgets load and fail independently with skeletons, not one global spinner.

items.title: Charts are accessible
items.description: Data available as a table or text summary; colour isn't the only encoding.

checklists.title: Settings
checklists.description: Where users make the product theirs without fear of breaking something.

items.title: Grouped and scoped
items.description: Personal, workspace and billing settings are separated and labelled by who they affect.

items.title: Consistent save model
items.description: Either autosave with confirmation or explicit save — never mixed on one page.

items.title: Unsaved changes warning
items.description: Leaving with pending edits prompts the user.

items.title: Settings search
items.description: For apps with more than a couple of pages of settings.

items.title: Danger zone isolated
items.description: Destructive actions are visually separated and require confirmation.

items.title: Explains impact
items.description: Each non-obvious setting says what changes and for whom.

checklists.title: Data Table
checklists.description: Dense information people need to scan, compare and act on in bulk.

items.title: Aligned columns
items.description: Text left, numbers right with tabular figures, consistent units in headers.

items.title: Sort and filter
items.description: Sortable headers with visible sort state; filters reflected in the URL.

items.title: Sticky header and first column
items.description: Context stays visible while scrolling large tables.

items.title: Bulk actions
items.description: Select rows, see the count selected, act on all at once.

items.title: Predictable pagination
items.description: Page size control and total count, or virtualised scrolling for big sets.

items.title: Table semantics
items.description: Real table, th with scope, and a caption — not a grid of divs.

items.title: No-results state
items.description: Distinguishes 'no data yet' from 'filters hid everything' and offers to clear filters.

items.title: Small-screen strategy
items.description: Horizontal scroll with a hint, or a card layout below a breakpoint.

checklists.title: Empty State
checklists.description: The moment between nothing and value — often a user's first impression.

items.title: Explains why it's empty
items.description: New account, no results, or no permission — each gets its own message.

items.title: Primary action to fill it
items.description: One clear button that creates the first item or imports data.

items.title: Shows what good looks like
items.description: An illustration, sample or template of the populated state.

items.title: Link to learn more
items.description: A guide or short video for users who aren't ready to act.

items.title: Encouraging tone
items.description: Copy is helpful, never blaming ('You haven't…').

checklists.title: Onboarding
checklists.description: Gets a new user to their first success as fast as possible.

items.title: Defined first success
items.description: Onboarding is built around one measurable 'aha' action.

items.title: Ask only what personalises
items.description: Every question changes the experience; everything else waits.

items.title: Visible progress
items.description: A step count or checklist shows how much is left.

items.title: Skippable and resumable
items.description: Users can skip and come back without losing what they entered.

items.title: Sample data
items.description: Optional demo content so users can explore before investing.

items.title: Invite teammates at the right time
items.description: Prompt after first value, not before.

checklists.title: Notifications
checklists.description: Keeps people informed without training them to ignore you.

items.title: Actionable content
items.description: Each notification says who did what and links straight to it.

items.title: Read / unread state
items.description: Clear unread indicator, mark one or all as read.

items.title: Grouped bursts
items.description: Similar events collapse ('5 comments on Q3 plan').

items.title: Granular preferences
items.description: Per channel and per event type, reachable from the notification itself.

items.title: Announced to assistive tech
items.description: New notifications use a polite live region, not focus theft.

items.title: Caught-up state
items.description: A calm message when there's nothing new.

checklists.title: Billing
checklists.description: Where trust is won or lost: plans, invoices and payment methods.

items.title: Current plan at a glance
items.description: Plan, price, renewal date and usage against limits.

items.title: Self-serve plan changes
items.description: Upgrade and downgrade with a prorated preview before confirming.

items.title: Downloadable invoices
items.description: History with PDF downloads and editable billing details (address, tax ID).

items.title: Payment method management
items.description: Update card, see last 4 digits and expiry, warn before expiry.

items.title: Failed payment recovery
items.description: Clear banner, retry and grace period before access is cut.

items.title: Findable cancellation
items.description: Cancel is available here, not hidden behind support.

checklists.title: Login
checklists.description: The fastest possible path back into the app.

items.title: Password manager friendly
items.description: Correct content types / autocomplete hints so credentials autofill.

items.title: Right keyboard
items.description: Email keyboard for email, return key moves to the next field.

items.title: Platform sign-in
items.description: Sign in with Apple/Google where accounts allow it.

items.title: Biometric re-entry
items.description: Face ID / fingerprint for returning users after first login.

items.title: Show password toggle
items.description: Reduces typos on small keyboards.

items.title: Specific, safe errors
items.description: Helpful messages that don't reveal whether an account exists.

items.title: Forgot password nearby
items.description: Visible next to the password field, pre-fills the entered email.

checklists.title: Onboarding
checklists.description: First launch that earns permission and attention.

items.title: Value before sign-up
items.description: Let people try something before demanding an account where possible.

items.title: Three screens or fewer
items.description: Intro carousels longer than that get skipped.

items.title: Permissions in context
items.description: Ask for camera, location or notifications when the feature needs it, with a pre-prompt.

items.title: Skip is visible
items.description: A clear skip control on every intro screen.

items.title: Respects safe areas
items.description: Content clears notches, home indicator and dynamic island.

items.title: Personalisation pays off
items.description: Choices made during onboarding visibly change the first screen.

checklists.title: Paywall
checklists.description: Converts without dark patterns and passes store review.

items.title: Benefits, not features
items.description: Three to four outcomes the user gets, with icons.

items.title: Real price is prominent
items.description: Billed amount and period are as visible as any 'per week' framing.

items.title: Trial terms explicit
items.description: When the trial ends and what is charged, with an optional reminder.

items.title: Close is easy to find
items.description: A visible dismiss control with an adequate hit area.

items.title: Restore purchases
items.description: Required by app stores and saves support tickets.

items.title: Terms and privacy links
items.description: Visible on the paywall itself.

checklists.title: Tab Bar
checklists.description: Primary navigation that should be learnable in seconds.

items.title: Three to five tabs
items.description: More belongs in a 'More' or profile area.

items.title: Icons with labels
items.description: Text labels under icons; icons alone are ambiguous.

items.title: Clear active state
items.description: Selected tab differs by more than colour alone.

items.title: Preserves state
items.description: Switching tabs keeps scroll position and stack; re-tapping scrolls to top.

items.title: Comfortable targets
items.description: At least 44pt (iOS) / 48dp (Android) per tab.

items.title: Restrained badges
items.description: Badges only for things that need attention, cleared when seen.

checklists.title: Push Notification Opt-in
checklists.description: Earns the right to interrupt.

items.title: Ask after value
items.description: Request after a moment where notifications clearly help, never on first launch.

items.title: Soft pre-prompt
items.description: An in-app explanation before the one-shot system dialog.

items.title: Concrete examples
items.description: Show what kind of notifications they'll get and how often.

items.title: Graceful when denied
items.description: App works fine; settings explain how to enable later.

items.title: In-app controls
items.description: Per-category toggles inside the app, not just OS settings.

checklists.title: Search
checklists.description: Finding things fast on a small screen with a clumsy keyboard.

items.title: Recent and suggested
items.description: Focused empty field shows recent searches and popular queries.

items.title: Results as you type
items.description: Debounced live results with highlighted matches.

items.title: Typo tolerant
items.description: Fuzzy matching and 'did you mean' for misspellings.

items.title: Clear and cancel
items.description: One tap to clear text, another to exit search.

items.title: Helpful no-results
items.description: Suggest broader terms, categories or removing filters.

items.title: Keyboard gets out of the way
items.description: Scrolling results dismisses the keyboard.

checklists.title: Button
checklists.description: The most used interactive component — every state matters.

items.title: Clear hierarchy
items.description: Primary, secondary, tertiary and destructive variants with defined usage.

items.title: All states designed
items.description: Default, hover, focus-visible, active, disabled and loading.

items.title: Visible focus ring
items.description: At least 3:1 contrast against adjacent colours.

items.title: Minimum target size
items.description: 24×24 CSS px minimum; 44px recommended on touch.

items.title: Verb-first labels
items.description: 'Save changes' beats 'OK'; icon-only buttons have an accessible name.

items.title: Loading keeps width
items.description: Spinner replaces content without layout shift and prevents double submit.

items.title: Right element
items.description: <button> for actions, <a> for navigation.

checklists.title: Input Field
checklists.description: Where users give you data — make it forgiving.

items.title: Persistent visible label
items.description: Placeholder is never the only label.

items.title: Helper text
items.description: Format hints shown before the user makes a mistake.

items.title: Inline error with fix
items.description: Error text explains how to fix it, linked via aria-describedby; not colour alone.

items.title: All states
items.description: Default, hover, focus, filled, error, disabled, read-only.

items.title: Correct input types
items.description: type, inputmode and autocomplete set so mobile keyboards and autofill work.

items.title: Required vs optional marked
items.description: Mark the minority consistently.

items.title: Character limits
items.description: Show remaining characters near the limit instead of truncating silently.

checklists.title: Modal
checklists.description: Interrupts on purpose — so it has to be worth it and easy to escape.

items.title: Justified interruption
items.description: Used for focused tasks or confirmations, not for content that could live on the page.

items.title: Focus managed
items.description: Focus moves in on open, is trapped while open, and returns to the trigger on close.

items.title: Multiple ways out
items.description: Close button, Esc key and (for non-destructive) backdrop click.

items.title: Dialog semantics
items.description: role=dialog/aria-modal or native <dialog>, labelled by its title.

items.title: Scroll handled
items.description: Body scroll locked; long content scrolls inside with sticky actions.

items.title: Mobile presentation
items.description: Full-screen or bottom sheet on small screens.

checklists.title: Toast
checklists.description: Brief, non-blocking feedback.

items.title: Short and specific
items.description: One line describing what happened ('Invoice sent').

items.title: Undo for reversible actions
items.description: Prefer undo over 'Are you sure?' dialogs.

items.title: Enough time to read
items.description: Persists on hover/focus; actionable toasts don't auto-dismiss too fast.

items.title: Announced
items.description: Rendered in a live region (status/alert by severity).

items.title: Stacking rules
items.description: Max visible count, consistent position, doesn't cover primary actions.

items.title: Not for critical errors
items.description: Errors that need action stay inline or in a banner.

checklists.title: Tooltip
checklists.description: Supplementary hints, never essential information.

items.title: Supplementary only
items.description: Nothing required to complete a task lives only in a tooltip.

items.title: Hover and focus
items.description: Appears on keyboard focus too, not just mouse hover.

items.title: Dismissible and hoverable
items.description: Esc closes it; pointer can move onto it without it vanishing.

items.title: Touch alternative
items.description: On touch devices use a tap-to-reveal or inline text instead.

items.title: Smart positioning
items.description: Flips to stay in the viewport and points at its trigger.

checklists.title: Color System
checklists.description: A palette that works in every theme and for every eye.

items.title: Semantic tokens
items.description: Components use roles (surface, text-muted, danger) not raw hex values.

items.title: Contrast-checked pairs
items.description: Text pairs meet 4.5:1 (3:1 for large text and UI).

items.title: Dark theme designed, not inverted
items.description: Elevation, saturation and shadows rethought for dark surfaces.

items.title: Status colours plus icons
items.description: Success, warning, danger and info never rely on colour alone.

items.title: Consistent scales
items.description: Each hue has a ramp with perceptually even steps.

items.title: Data-viz palette
items.description: A separate categorical palette that stays distinguishable for colour-blind users.

checklists.title: Typography
checklists.description: The type scale everything else hangs off.

items.title: Defined type scale
items.description: A limited set of sizes with named roles (display, h1–h4, body, caption).

items.title: Scales with user settings
items.description: Sizes in rem; layout survives 200% text zoom.

items.title: Readable body size
items.description: 16px minimum for body text on the web.

items.title: Line height per role
items.description: Tighter for headings, ~1.5 for body.

items.title: Font loading strategy
items.description: font-display, subsetting and fallback metrics to avoid layout shift.

items.title: Tabular numbers where needed
items.description: Tables, prices and timers use tabular figures.

checklists.title: Design Tokens
checklists.description: The single source of truth shared by design and code.

items.title: Tiered tokens
items.description: Primitive → semantic → component tiers; components only consume semantic or component tokens.

items.title: Predictable naming
items.description: A documented naming grammar (category-property-variant-state).

items.title: Synced to code
items.description: Tokens generated from one source into CSS, iOS and Android outputs.

items.title: Theme-ready
items.description: Light, dark and high-contrast modes swap at the semantic layer.

items.title: Spacing and radius scales
items.description: 4 or 8-based spacing and a small radius set.

items.title: Motion tokens
items.description: Durations and easings named and reduced under prefers-reduced-motion.

checklists.title: Accessibility Foundations
checklists.description: Baseline accessibility that every component inherits.

items.title: Fully keyboard operable
items.description: Every interaction works with Tab, Shift+Tab, Enter, Space, Esc and arrows where expected.

items.title: Logical focus order
items.description: Matches visual order; no positive tabindex.

items.title: Accessible names
items.description: Every control has a name matching its visible label.

items.title: Reduced motion
items.description: Non-essential animation disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

items.title: Reflow at 320px
items.description: No two-dimensional scrolling at 400% zoom.

items.title: Skip link and landmarks
items.description: Skip-to-content link; header, nav, main and footer landmarks.

items.title: Tested with assistive tech
items.description: Checked with a screen reader and automated tooling (axe, Lighthouse).

checklists.title: Signing up
checklists.description: From interest to account with as little friction as possible.

items.title: Minimum fields
items.description: Email and password (or passwordless); everything else after sign-up.

items.title: Rules shown upfront
items.description: Password requirements visible while typing, not after failure.

items.title: Social / SSO options
items.description: Offered where your audience expects them.

items.title: Verification doesn't block
items.description: Users can start exploring while email verification is pending where risk allows.

items.title: Existing account handled
items.description: Guides to login or reset without leaking account existence to strangers.

items.title: Clear consent
items.description: Terms/privacy linked; marketing opt-in unticked by default.

items.title: Bot protection
items.description: Rate limiting and invisible checks before visible CAPTCHAs.

checklists.title: Resetting password
checklists.description: Getting locked-out users back in, securely.

items.title: Same message for any email
items.description: 'If an account exists, we sent a link' — prevents enumeration.

items.title: Expiring single-use links
items.description: Token expires (e.g. 30–60 min) and works once.

items.title: Resend with cooldown
items.description: Resend option with a visible timer and spam-folder hint.

items.title: Strong new password UX
items.description: Requirements visible, show-password toggle, no confirm field needed if toggle exists.

items.title: Other sessions signed out
items.description: Option (or default) to sign out other devices after reset.

items.title: Change notification
items.description: Email confirming the change with a 'this wasn't me' link.

items.title: Lands signed in
items.description: User is signed in after reset rather than sent back to login.

checklists.title: Checking out
checklists.description: The last mile before revenue — remove every reason to leave.

items.title: Guest checkout
items.description: Account creation optional, offered after purchase.

items.title: Total cost early
items.description: Shipping, tax and fees shown before the payment step.

items.title: Step indicator
items.description: Shows where the user is and how many steps remain.

items.title: Address and card autofill
items.description: Correct autocomplete attributes; wallet payments (Apple/Google Pay).

items.title: Inline validation
items.description: Errors next to the field, preserved input, card errors explained plainly.

items.title: Trust cues
items.description: Security, returns and support info near the pay button.

items.title: Confirmation page and email
items.description: Order number, summary, delivery estimate and next steps.

items.title: No double charges
items.description: Pay button disabled while processing; idempotent payment requests.

checklists.title: Canceling subscription
checklists.description: An honest exit that keeps the door open.

items.title: Easy to find
items.description: Reachable from billing settings in a couple of clicks.

items.title: Explain what happens
items.description: When access ends, what data is kept, and for how long.

items.title: Offer alternatives once
items.description: Pause, downgrade or discount — one screen, easy to decline.

items.title: Optional reason
items.description: Short, skippable survey.

items.title: Confirmation
items.description: On-screen and by email with the effective date.

items.title: Easy to come back
items.description: One-click reactivation before the period ends.

checklists.title: Deleting account
checklists.description: Irreversible, legally regulated, and a test of trust.

items.title: Self-serve deletion
items.description: Available in-app (required by app stores and privacy laws in many regions).

items.title: Export first
items.description: Offer a data export before deleting.

items.title: Spell out the impact
items.description: Subscriptions, shared content and team ownership consequences listed.

items.title: Deliberate confirmation
items.description: Re-authentication or typing a phrase; destructive styling.

items.title: Grace period
items.description: A recovery window, clearly stated, before permanent deletion.

items.title: Deletion receipt
items.description: Email confirming the request and the final deletion date.

checklists.title: Submitting a form
checklists.description: From first field to confirmed submission without lost work.

items.title: Single column layout
items.description: One field per row, top-aligned labels.

items.title: Validate at the right time
items.description: On blur or submit, not on every keystroke.

items.title: Error summary on submit
items.description: Summary at top linking to each invalid field; focus moves to it.

items.title: Never lose input
items.description: Values persist after errors, network failures and accidental navigation.

items.title: Pending state
items.description: Submit shows progress and blocks duplicate submissions.

items.title: Clear success
items.description: Confirmation says what happens next and when.

items.title: Network failure handled
items.description: Explains the failure and offers retry without retyping.

checklists.title: Uploading media
checklists.description: Getting files in, with honest progress and recoverable failures.

items.title: Multiple input methods
items.description: Drag and drop plus a keyboard-accessible file picker; paste where useful.

items.title: Limits stated upfront
items.description: Allowed types, max size and count shown before upload.

items.title: Per-file progress
items.description: Progress, cancel and remove for each file.

items.title: Specific failure reasons
items.description: Too large, wrong type, network — each with a retry.

items.title: Preview before commit
items.description: Thumbnails or names to confirm the right files.

items.title: Resumable large uploads
items.description: Chunked uploads survive flaky connections.

items.title: Metadata handling
items.description: Strip or disclose EXIF/location data on images.

kits.title: Launch a landing page
kits.description: Everything to ship a marketing site that converts.

kits.title: SaaS web app
kits.description: Core screens and flows for a subscription product.

kits.title: Mobile app MVP
kits.description: First release of an iOS / Android app.

kits.title: Design system v1
kits.description: Foundations and core components for a new system.

kits.title: E-commerce store
kits.description: From product discovery to a confirmed order.
